items.text: Puka Nacua missed Friday practice (hip); added to report. Donald plans to play MNF vs NYG. Monitor Saturday for designation.
items.why: Hip (possible related to prior psoas/core); Whittington also DNP.
items.implication: MNF risk; Adams/others if limited/out. High priority monitor.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target share rise if absent.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) biggest injury on slate, QUESTIONABLE after limited Friday practice; affects Herbert/Chargers projections heavily. Late 4pm window. ETR Q list.
items.why: Rib injury from W1; practiced limited Friday per Rapoport/Schefter.
items.implication: Monitor inactives; if OUT Quentin Johnston/others rise, Herbert downgrade. Levitan: cascades to many projections.
items.opportunity: Johnston boost if out; routes/targets vacuum.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs CIN after missing practice; ETR lists under OUT OR DOUBTFUL. Corroborated by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in Wednesday practice; DNP all week.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; HOU WR room opens (Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel volume); Dalton Schultz TE bump.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets previously concentrated on Collins (37 routes W1); handcuffs/streamers rise.

items.text: Zay Flowers DOUBTFUL (hamstring) with Ja'Kobi Lane also out; ETR OUT/DOUBTFUL list. Rapoport/Schefter confirm doubtful after limited/return Friday.
items.why: Hamstring re-aggravation; missed Wed/Thu, limited Fri; long-term management.
items.implication: Expect OUT; BAL WRs to crumbs (Bateman primary); Mark Andrews target bump; NO@BAL pace up helps volume.
items.opportunity: Bateman snap/target hierarchy rise; Andrews 25% share potential with Flowers/Lane out.

items.text: Brock Bowers DOUBTFUL (knee/meniscus) for LV@LAC; practiced limited Friday after surgery recovery. ETR OUT/DOUBTFUL; Rapoport notes doubtful.
items.implication: Prepare replacement; if active limited role risk. LV@LAC slow pace slog.
items.opportunity: TE streamers; Jeanty already high util independent.

items.text: Joe Burrow listed QUESTIONABLE (back) but said he's playing; Rapoport headlines 'good to go'. ETR notes Q (said playing). Schefter confirms listing.
items.why: Back injury; full practice/said playing; Rapoport confirmation.
items.implication: Start confidently vs HOU; CIN offense intact opposite Collins OUT.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR. Levitan: potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson; nice upcoming schedule before bye.
items.why: Ready to go per reports; ETR IN list. Brown ankle IR.
items.implication: Committee but explosive upside; monitor touch share vs Stevenson. ROS schedule favorable.
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential; goal-line/third-down competition; NE WR crumbs.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN; ETR Sunday injuries. Returns squeezes Etienne/Miller committee further in NO@BAL (up-tempo pace).
items.implication: Etienne downgrade (W1 matched Miller rushes, air-heavy); three-headed backfield risk. Pace helps overall volume.
items.opportunity: Kamara third-down/pass work; Etienne early-down squeeze.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 Utilization Score W1 (2nd only Bijan), 19% tgt share recent; overreaction to injury scare. @LAC soft.
items.why: Kubiak offense high util; consistent targets.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start; volume floor high.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24%+ target share (tied lead), 40% routes targeted, 74% snaps/21-of-24 RB touches W1 vs IND (soft vs Henry). RB1 overall range.
items.why: Elite W1 receiving util + matchup; 10 Facts data.
items.implication: Must-start RB; massive season upside if healthy.
items.opportunity: 24% tgt share, high route participation, IND run defense soft.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey bump off W1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) Q status matters for SF backfield split.
items.why: W1 usage data; Black Q impacts.
items.implication: CMC start with confidence; monitor Black for any committee.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share expansion potential if Black limited.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: 26% target share career-high, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8; CLE soft run. Util RB9.
Justin Jefferson LOVE (37% tgt from Wentz, career avg 18 PPG w/ him @CHI); DeVonta Smith LOVE (27% tgt, 13.7 aDOT, TEN soft secondary).
items.why: Volume/matchup data; Wentz history for JJ; aDOT/TEN for Smith.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE: W1 matched Miller rushes, air-dependent; Kamara IN squeezes further @BAL. Marvin Harrison Jr HATE: 8% tgt share (5th on team), 0 RZ, tough SEA.
items.why: Usage collapse risk with Kamara; MHJ low share/no RZ + matchup.
